name: Personal Effects Inventory Deceased Meridian PD Officer Badge 4419
author: Meridian PD Internal Affairs Division
description:
PERSONAL EFFECTS INVENTORY — DECEASED OFFICER OFFICER: Badge #4419, Constable Dariusz Mbeki-Osei DATE OF DEATH: 2200-02-28 CAUSE: Line of duty — structural collapse during the Gray Zone Block 22 fire response INVENTORY CONDUCTED BY: Sgt. Lena Achebe-Park, Internal Affairs

Effects recovered from officer's locker, Station 14: - Meridian PD service uniform, 3 sets (worn, regulation-compliant) - Personal sidearm: Kang-Petrov Arms KP-19 'Workhorse' (not department issue; officer's personal weapon, registered) - Department-issued sidearm: Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-P1 'Centurion' (returned to armory) - Notebook, physical paper, approximately 200 pages of handwritten entries (see Note 1) - Photograph, printed, showing officer with two children and an unidentified woman at what appears to be the Lakefront Promenade - Religious medallion, tarnished silver, depicting Saint Michael - Comm device, personal (locked; family has been asked to provide access code) - Φ340 in physical currency (unusual amount for an officer's locker; see Note 2)

Note 1: The notebook contains a mix of case notes, personal observations, and what appear to be poems. Several entries reference frustration with department response times in the Gray Zone districts and a belief that the Gray Zone residents are 'treated as a lower priority than the paperwork about them.' The notebook has been flagged for IA review per standard protocol, though nothing in its contents suggests misconduct.

Note 2: The Φ340 in physical currency is notable because Officer Mbeki-Osei's bank records show a balance of Φ89. Physical currency holdings exceeding liquid savings may indicate off-book income. However, given the officer's known habit of collecting physical currency 'because the mesh goes down and Φ doesn't,' this is more likely personal eccentricity than corruption.

Family notification completed. Benefits processing initiated. The notebook will be returned to the family after IA review, with the poems intact.
